marketInfo.assetDescription:
sUSDx is the rewards vault of USDx from Axis Protocol. Deposits are compounded via a market-neutral trading engine spanning cross-venue arbitrage, cross-currency arbitrage, funding rate arbitrage, and OTC/RFQ strategies, plus yield-bearing margin (T-bills and tokenized money-market funds).

Refer to Axis's yield source page for the full strategy breakdown.
marketInfo.riskInvolved:
sUSDx holders retain all USDx risks plus additional exposure to vault performance and the redemption process. Negative yield may occur when:

  • Market-neutral strategies underperform — funding reverses, spot/perp prices diverge, or margin becomes insufficient
  • Counterparty or venue failures cause backing losses
  • Slippage, partial fills, or latency eliminate expected spreads

(From Underlying Protocol)
marketInfo.importantQuirks: • There is a 7-day cooldown period for unstaking sUSDx to USDx.

marketInfo.assetDescription:
USD3 is a senior tranche and sits ahead of sUSD3 in the waterfall: it is paid first and is the last to be impaired. USD3 is credit-enhanced — it sits behind originator first-loss equity, overcollateralization, reserves, performance triggers, and the sUSD3 junior tranche beneath it.

USD3 yield is a variable share of pool interest that floats with what the backing generates here.

There is an ongoing $JANE emissions program for this pool. Refer to the here for the latest APY and reward details.

marketInfo.importantQuirks:
• Redemptions are available up to the amount of liquidity available in the lending pool.
  • There is a minimum amount of $1000 required to mint USD3

marketInfo.assetDescription:
USD.AI is a synthetic dollar protocol designed to finance the physical infrastructure of AI (Compute) and other emerging sectors. sUSDai is the yield-bearing token backed by income-generating Compute or other infrastructure assets. These assets are inherently less liquid than stablecoins, so holders accrue yield for the added risk and are also subject to redemption periods.

The pool will also earn additional points which entitles users to airdrop during USD.AI TGE.
marketInfo.riskInvolved: The pool could generate negative yield if the loan that has been originated has defaulted. In this situation, the collateral will be sold to recoup the value of the loan, which may be lower than the remaining principal on the original loan - which leads to negative yield. (from underlying protocol)
marketInfo.importantQuirks:
• The minting cap for USDai has been reached. Users will swap their input token into USDai via a DEX to obtain USDai. Be aware of potential price impact when swapping.
  • Points earned for this pool entitles you to airdrop for USD.AI tokens, rather than allocation to purchase USD.AI tokens during TGE. Refer here for more details.
  • No KYC is required for airdrop earned from this pool.

marketInfo.assetDescription:
sUSDD represents the yield-bearing version of USDD. Yield is generated through the Smart Allocator, which manages the USDD protocol's over-collateralized reserves.

To generate yield, the Smart Allocator identifies and moves idle reserve assets into whitelisted DeFi protocols (such as JustLend DAO, Spark, or Morpho). The earnings are then funneled back and generates yield for sUSDD.
